description: Impianti Fotovoltaici is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by dati.unionevallesavio.it. Photovoltaic plants of the Municipality of Cesena. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Photovoltaic systems" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/conditionsUnknown). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
